title: Washroom Ka Tap Haath Kaise Pehchanta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Washroom ka tap bina chhue kaise chalta hai? Jawab aapko hairan kar dega!
💡 Dekhiye ki tap haath ki garmi nahi, kuch aur pakadta hai
🔦 IR LED aur photodiode ka asli khel
🧠 Circuit kaise decide karta hai ki paani chalu karna hai
🚰 Solenoid valve kaise khulta aur band hota hai
🧽 Tap na chale toh kya karein, ek aasan tip
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
